
    private AuthorizationRequest driveAuthorizationRequest() {
        return AuthorizationRequest.builder()
                .setRequestedScopes(Arrays.asList(
                        new Scope(DRIVE_APPDATA_SCOPE),
                        new Scope(DRIVE_FILE_SCOPE)))
                .build();
    }

    private void acceptDriveAuthorization(AuthorizationResult result) {
        if (result == null || result.getAccessToken() == null || result.getAccessToken().isEmpty()) {
            notifyDriveAuth(false, "No Google Drive access token returned");
            return;
        }
        driveAccessToken = result.getAccessToken();
        notifyDriveAuth(true, "Google Drive connected");
    }

    private void notifyDriveAuth(boolean ok, String message) {
        final String js = "window.onNativeDriveAuth && window.onNativeDriveAuth(" + ok + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(message == null ? "" : message) + ");";
        runOnUiThread(() -> webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null));
    }

    private void notifyDriveSync(boolean ok, String message) {
        final String js = "window.onNativeDriveSync && window.onNativeDriveSync(" + ok + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(message == null ? "" : message) + ");";
        runOnUiThread(() -> webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null));
    }

    private class DriveSyncBridge {
        @JavascriptInterface
        public void connectGoogleDrive() {
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (driveAuthorizationClient == null) {
                    driveAuthorizationClient = Identity.getAuthorizationClient(MainActivity.this);
                }
                driveAuthorizationClient.authorize(driveAuthorizationRequest())
                        .addOnSuccessListener(result -> {
                            if (result.hasResolution()) {
                                PendingIntent pi = result.getPendingIntent();
                                if (pi == null) {
                                    notifyDriveAuth(false, "Google authorization needs a resolution but returned no intent");
                                    return;
                                }
                                try {
                                    startIntentSenderForResult(pi.getIntentSender(), DRIVE_AUTH_REQUEST, null, 0, 0, 0);
                                } catch (Exception e) {
                                    notifyDriveAuth(false, "Could not open Google authorization: " + e.getMessage());
                                }
                            } else {
                                acceptDriveAuthorization(result);
                            }
                        })
                        .addOnFailureListener(e -> notifyDriveAuth(false, "Google Drive authorization failed: " + e.getMessage()));
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void disconnectGoogleDrive() {
            driveAccessToken = null;
            notifyDriveAuth(false, "Disconnected");
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public boolean isGoogleDriveConnected() {
            return driveAccessToken != null && !driveAccessToken.isEmpty();
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void syncGoogleDrive(String payloadJson) {
            final String token = driveAccessToken;
            if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
                notifyDriveSync(false, "Connect Google Drive first");
                return;
            }
            final String payload = payloadJson == null ? "{}" : payloadJson;
            new Thread(() -> {
                try {
                    uploadDriveSnapshot(token, payload);
                    notifyDriveSync(true, "Google Drive sync complete");
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    notifyDriveSync(false, "Sync failed: " + e.getMessage());
                }
            }, "MyReaderDriveSync").start();
        }
    }

    private void uploadDriveSnapshot(String token, String payloadJson) throws Exception {
        String boundary = "myreader_" + System.currentTimeMillis();
        String metadata = "{\"name\":\"myreader-sync.json\",\"parents\":[\"appDataFolder\"]}";
        byte[] body = ("--" + boundary + "\r\n" +
                "Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n" + metadata + "\r\n" +
                "--" + boundary + "\r\n" +
                "Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n" + payloadJson + "\r\n" +
                "--" + boundary + "--\r\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        URL url = new URL("https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id,name");
        HttpURLConnection c = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
        c.setRequestMethod("POST");
        c.setDoOutput(true);
        c.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        c.setReadTimeout(20000);
        c.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
        c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "multipart/related; boundary=" + boundary);
        try (OutputStream os = c.getOutputStream()) {
            os.write(body);
        }
        int code = c.getResponseCode();
        if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
            BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(
                    c.getErrorStream() != null ? c.getErrorStream() : c.getInputStream(),
                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line);
            throw new Exception("Drive API " + code + ": " + sb);
        }
        c.disconnect();
    }
